checkCodeProgram.source:
*** Patient registry A entry checks for the synthetic RECORDLINK lesson

DefineVariables
  DEFINE ContinueToSurveillance STANDARD YN
End-DefineVariables

Page Identity
  Before
    ENABLE record_id first_name middle_name last_name
  End-Before
End-Page

Page Demographics
  Before
    ENABLE date_of_birth sex patient_address art_code facility_code
  End-Before
End-Page

Field record_id
  After
    IF record_id = "" OR record_id = (.) THEN
      HIGHLIGHT record_id
      DIALOG "Registry A records need a source record identifier before linkage." TITLETEXT="Linkage data quality"
    ELSE
      UNHIGHLIGHT record_id
      GOTO first_name
    END-IF
  End-After
End-Field

Field last_name
  After
    IF NOT (last_name = "" OR last_name = (.)) THEN
      GOTOPAGE Demographics
    END-IF
  End-After
End-Field

Field facility_code
  After
    IF NOT (record_id = "" OR record_id = (.)) AND NOT (facility_code = "" OR facility_code = (.)) THEN
      DIALOG "Continue to the surveillance source form? The valid registry draft will remain available in this browser session." ContinueToSurveillance YN TITLETEXT="Cross-form Check Code"
      IF ContinueToSurveillance THEN
        GOTOFORM surveillance-b
      END-IF
    END-IF
  End-After
End-Field

*** Surveillance B entry checks for the synthetic RECORDLINK lesson

Page Identity
  Before
    ENABLE client_id given_name middle family_name
  End-Before
End-Page

Page Demographics
  Before
    ENABLE DOB SEX Address ART_CODE site_code
  End-Before
End-Page

Field client_id
  After
    IF client_id = "" OR client_id = (.) THEN
      HIGHLIGHT client_id
      DIALOG "Surveillance B records need a client identifier before linkage." TITLETEXT="Linkage data quality"
    ELSE
      UNHIGHLIGHT client_id
      GOTO given_name
    END-IF
  End-After
End-Field

Field family_name
  After
    IF NOT (family_name = "" OR family_name = (.)) THEN
      GOTOPAGE Demographics
    END-IF
  End-After
End-Field

programs.name: recordlink-command-tour
programs.author: Epi Info AI
programs.comment: Synthetic teaching workflow; V0.11 pauses for governed review, prepares clusters and audit tables, and offers an acknowledged DuckDB analytical output without changing project tables.
programs.source:
*** Epi Info AI RECORDLINK end-to-end command tour
*** Datasets: patient-registry-a.csv and surveillance-b.csv (entirely synthetic)
*** Purpose: inspect both sources before proposing cross-source patient links.
*** New branch; not the legacy matched case-control MATCH command.
*** V0.11 adds an acknowledged DuckDB target to the typed governed stages.

HEADER 1 "Synthetic patient record-linkage teaching workflow"
TYPEOUT "Two fictional eight-record sources use different schemas and contain five known truth links."
TYPEOUT "Review source quality and aggregate distributions before evaluating any proposed link."

READ patient_registry_a
HEADER 1 "Source A — synthetic patient registry"
EPIAI QUALITY *
LIST record_id date_of_birth sex art_code facility_code first_name last_name patient_address
FREQ facility_code
FREQ sex
TABLES facility_code sex

READ surveillance_b
HEADER 1 "Source B — synthetic surveillance line list"
EPIAI QUALITY *
LIST client_id DOB SEX ART_CODE site_code given_name family_name Address
FREQ site_code
FREQ SEX
TABLES site_code SEX

HEADER 1 "Reviewed cross-source linkage plan"
TYPEOUT "Block on facility/site; compare date, sex, and ART code exactly; compare names and address fuzzily."
EPIAI RECORDLINK SOURCEA=patient_registry_a SOURCEB=surveillance_b IDA=record_id IDB=client_id TRUTH=true_links TRUTHA=source_a_id TRUTHB=source_b_id BLOCK=facility_code:site_code EXACT=date_of_birth:DOB,sex:SEX,art_code:ART_CODE FUZZY=first_name:given_name,last_name:family_name,patient_address:Address FUZZYTHRESHOLD=0.85 REVIEWTHRESHOLD=4 MATCHTHRESHOLD=6 MAXCANDIDATES=10000 RESULT=PatientLinks
EPIAI RECORDLINK REVIEW RESULT=PatientLinks
EPIAI RECORDLINK CLUSTER RESULT=PatientLinks
EPIAI RECORDLINK AUDIT RESULT=PatientLinks
EPIAI RECORDLINK OUTPUT RESULT=PatientLinks TO="patientlinks.duckdb"

*** Candidate identifiers and values remain out of Output and history.
*** Review-queue values appear only in the transient local review dialog.
*** REVIEW pauses this program until every queued pair has a conclusive human decision.
*** AUDIT stays in memory; OUTPUT requires acknowledgement before CSV, JSON, or DuckDB download.
*** Future governed slices continue with project-table creation and an explicitly reviewed MERGE.

runbooks.title: Governed record-linkage project tour
runbooks.description: Run a typed linkage workflow that pauses for human review, then prepares clusters, audit tables, and acknowledged person output without merging records.
runbooks.prerequisite: Import the Synthetic Patient Record Linkage example project. It includes two source tables, five known truth links, and a saved command tour.

steps.title: Confirm the governed boundary
steps.instruction: The project contains two fictional eight-record sources and a five-link truth table. No comparison, threshold classification, or merge runs automatically when the project opens.

steps.title: Open the saved linkage workflow
steps.instruction: Select Open Pgm. The complete workflow is stored with the project.

steps.title: Load visible linkage source
steps.instruction: Choose recordlink-command-tour and select Open. Loading the program does not execute it.

steps.title: Verify the workflow
steps.instruction: Select Verify Program. Review the QUALITY, LIST, FREQ, TABLES, and governed EPIAI RECORDLINK commands before execution.

steps.title: Run reviewed comparisons
steps.instruction: Select Run Commands. The workflow blocks candidates, calculates deterministic scores, and pauses at EPIAI RECORDLINK REVIEW. Nothing mutates either source.

steps.title: Review candidate scores and classes
steps.instruction: Inspect blocking counts, score distribution, threshold classes, truth-set precision/recall/F1, and field-level contributions. Candidate identifiers and patient values remain out of Output and history.

steps.title: Record an explicit decision
steps.instruction: Compare the one-day date variation, choose Match and a controlled reason, then select Save decision. The program resumes through CLUSTER, AUDIT, and OUTPUT only after the review is conclusive.

steps.title: Export governed review evidence
steps.instruction: The completed program has prepared 11 person clusters, fingerprint-bound audit tables, and a person-record preview. Select Export review artifact if you want portable decision evidence; no export happened automatically.

steps.title: Export durable audit tables
steps.instruction: Inspect the opaque person and accepted-link previews prepared by the AUDIT program stage, then select Export audit tables if desired. Membership uses source record ordinals but excludes patient identifiers and values.

steps.title: Acknowledge the person-level output
steps.instruction: The OUTPUT program stage prepared the seven declared field mappings and 11 records. Review them, then select the acknowledgement. CSV, provenance JSON, and the declared patientlinks.duckdb download become available only now.

steps.title: Inspect the audit history
steps.instruction: Open History to confirm the source, plan version, status, and aggregate result summary.
